children.value: Vite

is the adapter for Vite 8 and Rolldown. It owns a compiler session,
compiles the modules that carry styles, serves the stylesheet in development and
writes it in a build.

children.value: In development

the plugin serves the live stylesheet and pushes updates
over Vite's hot channel, so a style change restyles the page without a reload.
A page that is still loading its modules on a cold start cannot take an
update yet; when the stylesheet runs, it tells the server which one it holds,
and the server sends a newer one.

children.value: Diagnostics in the terminal

Errors fail the build; warnings print with their file, line and help text. Info
diagnostics are quiet unless you pass

, which is useful when you
want to see every runtime bridge in an application.
Rolldown

Vite 8 is Rolldown-backed, and the plugin uses Rolldown's filters, so a
Rolldown-only setup works the same way.
